crossRefs.note: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”
She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings…
I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

people.name: Achzib
people.line: A town in Judah, birthplace of Shelah.

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Mareshah
people.line: A town in Judah; fortified by Rehoboam

translations.web: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah—nine cities, along with their villages.
